avoid_claims: 43 windows are not all RICH VAL windows, official TEST, or an external-method benchmark. RICH27 excludes one165-frame recording; TRUMANS/EgoBody8 each.
Dev12 were used at1000; all43 includes dev and cannot be called untouched holdout. Confirmation31 is held out from this trial gate; older base reports may contain its VAL identities.

Two DDIM sampling seeds are not two independent training seeds or86 independent recordings. Average metrics over sampling seeds and regimes inside recording before bootstrap27 RICH recordings. This is one paired training realization.

Foot low-speed mask is GT3D foot-joint velocity<.2m/s over adjacent-frame intervals, not labeled contact. Report valid recording n and GT opportunity denominators; do not double them for two seeds or treat count as aggregation weight. None stays missing, not0.

FootY is joint position error versus GT in native Y, not sole-ground distance, collision/penetration rate, support force, or guaranteed no floating. Acceleration is predicted-vs-GT error, not simply raw smoothness.
Observed-head error is distance to the supplied observation (which can be noisy), not error to clean GT head. It is a binding observation-fit guard in RICH/macro, not proof of overall pose accuracy.
physicsOFF disables iterative analytical scene guide_motion, while learned scene/contact feedback and observation anchoring/IK remain. No real physics simulation, gravity or tracker was added.
The22 queries are per temporal bottleneck bin, sharing all-body temporal features and region identity/pose; this is not an independent per-frame diffusion or a full joint-token transformer.

Additional module reuses existing tokens/query geometry without additional FK/queries; the complete model still performs its original FK/query work. Global attention is validity-gated; local hidden update is alpha_bar squared gated.

Same-model scene off switches all learned scene conditioning/feedback plus the new branch. Because earlier DDIM states then differ, on/off is a complete-trajectory condition ablation, not the isolated one-layer/raw correction effect.

An on/off gain alone does not prove fusion beats original scene conditioning. A pass concerns this exact fusion+training recipe; it does not isolate each added component or establish that every cross-attention architecture is superior.

This run is EGO/head-only. It neither validates current EXO robustness nor proves a unified EGO/EXO final model. Inputs in these datasets include derived/simulated observations, not a new real detector benchmark.
Stage step3000 starts from parent41000 with fresh optimizer; name it41k+3000 fine-tuning updates, not a continuous original44k training checkpoint or the legacy55k model.
